{{Quote|Jedi moocha.|Arok|<ref name="HFZ" />}}
'''Arok''' was an elder [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and a member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] led the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and sat on the Council until [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], when he mysteriously disappeared and was replaced by [[Aruk Besadii Aora]].

==Biography==
[[File:HuttGrandCouncil-EP.png|thumb|left|200px|Arok discussing Ziro's release.]]
Born within the mighty [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] somewhere on one of their controlled worlds in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], Arok was an influential member of his clan. At some point, he became the head, or [[Kajidii/Legends|Kajidii]], of the Besadii clan and earned a position on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> He also had the symbol of his clan [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on his upper left arm.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Arok discussed the plans to release [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody with other Hutt council members including [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], and [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]].<ref name="Evil Plans" /> They sought his release not out of loyalty, but rather because Ziro had potentially damaging information about Hutt activities.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

After the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] succeeded in freeing Ziro by holding the Republic Senate [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostage]], Ziro was brought before the Hutt Council on Nal Hutta.<ref name="HFZ" /> When he informed the council he knew all too well that his release was due to a [[Holodiary/Legends|holodiary]] he possessed which contained the [[Hutt Council records/Legends|Hutt Council records]], Arok angrily implied that the council could just as easily kill him.<ref name="HFZ" /> Ziro casually shrugged off the threat and stated that if he were killed, the diary would end up on the steps of the Senate. Afterwards, Ziro was taken to a holding cell.

Later, Arok and the council were entertained by the singer, [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], who performed the musical number [[Daa Hutt muna]]. Arok found the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] very entertaining.<ref name="HFZ" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:GardullaArokandGorga.png|thumb|left|200px|Arok, with [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]], and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]] speaking to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].]]</div>
Arok did not speak when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] appeared before the Council and informed them of Ziro's escape. Later, Arok, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and Gorga found that Ziro had escaped from his cell and claimed that the Jedi had freed the Hutt.<ref name="HFZ" /> Cad Bane disagreed and informed the Hutts that Ziro had been freed a long before the Jedi had arrived. Arok and the other Hutts managed to persuade Bane to attempt to recapture Ziro before the Jedi were able to return him to Republic custody.<ref name="HFZ" />

A [[20 BBY/Legends|year later]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] named [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and the leader of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], arrived in the Hutt Council chambers, requesting their allegiance and their territories in exchange for their lives being spared. Arok, Marlo and Oruba were the only Hutts present, while Gorga and Jabba attended by [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. The Hutt council laughed at the Sith's demands and summoned numerous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to attack the intruders. During the skirmish, one of the bounty hunters was thrown into Marlo, which Arok was shocked by because the intruders proved to be more powerful than the bounty hunters. When Maul and his forces retreated outside, Arok and Marlo managed to escape, but left Oruba behind, leading to his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>

Some months later, Arok was a guest of [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] on [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]]. Along with Gorga, Arok was present when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived to speak to Lom about [[Silman/Legends|Silman]] and [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]].<ref name="TLO">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Arok-concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Arok the Hutt]]
Already considered an elder [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="9th edition">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 9|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 9]]</ref> he seemed to have enough power in his [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] that he became the clan's [[Kajidii/Legends|kajidii]]. It was said that he also had a smoking habit and thus carried with him a cigarette-type [[Hookah pipe/Legends|Hookah]].<ref name="9th edition" />

Arok was a Hutt with average build and blue and yellow skin.<ref name="HFZ" /> He also had orange eyes and a different type of wrinkles on his body than other Hutts. At some point, like most of the Hutt Council, he had the symbol of his clan&mdash;the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadiis]]&mdash;tattooed on his left arm.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BesadiiBanner-HuntForZiro.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Arok's [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].]]
Arok is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="HFZ" /> Just as his "[[Hunt for Ziro]]" co-star [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo the Hutt]] is patterned after actor Marlon Brando, Arok's appearance was styled after the gangster character "Rico" in the [[Wikipedia:1931|1931]] film ''[[Wikipedia:Little Caeser|Little Caeser]]'''.<ref name="Insider125">{{InsiderCite|125|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season Three|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season Three}}</ref>
